title: Fat Bat Brewing Co.

services.name: HIDEaWAY Rental
services.desc: Fat Bat Brewing has a downstairs space available for rentals. From parties and reunions to community meetings and football drafts. Located right below the Tap House, the HIDEaWAY space can fit up to 35-40 people standing and about 20 seated. Your rental comes with 14 beer taps, your own bartender and a private bathroom. You also have access to upstairs for additional drinks including mocktails, sodas, and water. You may bring your own food. The rental fee includes an extra hour before and after for set-up and tear
